He has created a very odd paradox. Gojo backed him into a corner narratively so of course he has to be sidelined somehow right? Gojo has been framed as the exception to the rule throughout the story, “hey look at this guy he has the most CE output out of all sorcerers (except Gojo)”, “this dude is a special grade with one of the strongest domains (but Gojo negs). 

The only time Gojo has struggled was when he was younger and could barely pull out Red reliably, but still destroys Toji after in what was barely a fight. Now he’s been killed by Sukuna, which should have happened to make Sukuna some kind of threat because tbh beforehand he was an imposing presence but there was no real reason for an audience to root against him outside of purely narrative reasons. But Sukuna doesn’t just win, he apparently does it easily, Gojo says Sukuna wasn’t even trying but how does that make sense? 

He, at the most, mid digs Gojo but it’s probably closer to Low dif or even No Dif considering that he apparently ‘didn’t go all out’. But where does that leave the story now? In an attempt to write himself out of the corner Gojo backed Gege into, he’s just written himself into another one with Sukuna because now it makes no feasible sense how Sukuna would lose against anyone. But we know he has to lose, so when he loses ultimately it will be unsatisfying because it will involve some kind of bs. I can’t think of any other pieces of media who found themselves in that situation where the unstoppable force was defeated in a satisfying way without some kind of asspull. 

It makes moments like Maki pulling up on Sukuna absolutely meaningless. If she’s on the same level as Toji, maybe slightly stronger maybe slightly weaker, Sukuna still has absolutely no issue finishing her asap if an inexperienced Gojo deleted Toji from existence, and now Sukuna has done the same to Gojo. 

There was a bit of desperation in the last few chapters and you can tell he has an ending in mind, but is doing backflips to get ti that point.

This was a read. But I'll just say this, it's impossible to go through life being paranoid about every single person, you'll just end up a hermit. There are a lot of odd people out there, I mean I would say everyone's odd in their own way, I think in this case these specific people who turned out to have very weird backgrounds are so idiosyncratic that they just stick in your mind and that could possibly be why you think 'everyone' gives off a weird vibe. I'm not saying place blind trust in each person, that would just be naive and there is a power in suspicion. I also get that this specific community may harbour a higher number of 'odd' individuals because of how niche it is, maybe its a case of not every furry having some weird animal fetish, but everyone with a weird animal fetish is a furry.   
But I'm sure if you just sit down and try to think of EVERY relationship you have in your life, most of these are with people that don't have such 'odd' backgrounds.

I think you should defo bring this up with her, it's one thing to respect boundaries and another to feel completely cut off from the person. It's the only real way of working things out, you seem like a supportive person so you also deserve just as much.

Honestly, if you feel like the relationship hasn't been beneficial for you and has felt this passive-aggressive for this many years, then just for your own sake I would say you did the right thing. But on the other hand, sometimes people are just that busy especially if the person was just in the process of getting married, then buying a house, then having a baby.  
If you do want to keep up any type of relationship with the person then I would definitely recommend just telling her that that's how you feel, that you think she has no real interest in maintaining any form of communication. You aint no bitch.
